dataTable.pinnedColumnsDescription: Scroll horizontally to see the first two columns remain fixed on the left and Budget remain fixed on the right.
dataTable.table: TanStack table instance returned by useDataTable.
dataTable.children: Optional toolbar or custom content rendered above the table.
dataTable.actionBar: Selection actions shown when one or more filtered rows are selected.
dataTable.emptyStateContent: Custom Empty composition shown when the current row model has no rows.
dataTable.emptyMessage: Title used by the built-in Empty state. Active filters also add guidance and a clear-filter action.
dataTable.columns: Column definitions, headers, cells, and filter metadata.
dataTable.initialState: Initial sorting, pagination, visibility, and pinning state.
dataTable.options: Other TanStack Table options, including row selection and custom filter functions.
dataTable.label: Readable column label used by filters and view options.
dataTable.variant: Toolbar filter generated for this column.
dataTable.filterOptions: Options for select and multi-select filters.
dataTable.placeholder: Placeholder for text and number filters.
dataTable.unit: Optional suffix displayed inside a number filter.
